title: Library Visits Fell 46%, But Digital Borrowing More Than Doubled
hook: Library visits fell 46%, but readers moved online.
closing: The building emptied, but your library card became useful anywhere.
question: When did you last use a library?

segments.say: Library visits fell 46%, showing in-person traffic never fully recovered.
Digital library checkouts reached 739 million, proving borrowing moved to phones instead of disappearing.
